integrity: Finite exact-rational and floating-point checks supplement but do not replace the analytic infinite-iteration argument; historical priority and independent review remain open.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic, a consistent full-column-rank system with exactly two positive active spectral levels and SD first step; rounding and general spectra unproved; novelty risks from older short-step literature and weighted BB conjugacy.
title: Sharp all-start doubly-exponential decay for residual-difference gradient iteration on two spectral levels
